info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Form Instances API

params.name: id
params.description: Only return form instances with the given id.

params.name: formDefinitionId
params.description: Only return form instances with the given form definition id.

params.name: formDefinitionIdLike
params.description: Only return form instances with a form definition id like the given value.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Only return form instances with the given task id.

params.name: taskIdLike
params.description: Only return form instances with a task id like the given value.

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: Only return form instances with the given process instance id.

params.name: processInstanceIdLike
params.description: Only return form instances with a process instance id like the given value.

params.name: processDefinitionId
params.description: Only return form instances with the given process definition id.

params.name: processDefinitionIdLike
params.description: Only return form instances with a process definition id like the given value.

params.name: scopeId
params.description: Only return form instances with the given scope id.

params.name: scopeType
params.description: Only return form instances with a scope type like the given value.

params.name: scopeDefinitionId
params.description: Only return form instances with the given scope definition id.

params.name: submittedBy
params.description: Only return form instances submitted by the given value.

params.name: submittedByLike
params.description: Only return form instances submitted by like the given value.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return form instances with the given tenantId.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return form instances with a tenantId like the given value.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns form instances without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

params.name: sort
params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

items.docs: Provide either a FormDefinitionKey or a FormDefinitionId together with the other properties.

The request body can contain all possible filters that can be used in the List form instances URL query. On top of these, it’s possible to provide an array of variables to include in the query, with their format described here.

The general paging and sorting query-parameters can be used for this URL.
